items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Freddie was there. Like you say, Johnny Coles . . .

ctx.x: What was it like in the session with Quincy? What was the dynamic with it?

Quincy was in the control room with Creed, because Creed produced that. Creed has always been a guy who – very subtle. He never talks directly to the musicians. He always had a liason, always, because he – I don’t know. Even during – he had a little red phone on the desk. He had a little black phone on the desk. He used the red phone for one thing and the black phone was another. I think the red phone you talk directly to the guy on the podium – I mean, I guess you call it the podium. Whoever the conductor was.…
